# Safety Matches India (safetymatches.in) — by Glovel Matches LLP

> Product catalogue and export specifications for safety matches manufactured by Glovel Matches LLP. ISO 9001:2015 certified safety match manufacturer and B2B exporter based in Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, India. Part of the Glovel Group of Companies, which also manufactures and exports incense sticks and incense cones (see glovel.in). This site covers the safety matches range in full: wooden, wax, kitchen, barbeque and custom promotional matches, supplied by full container load to 52+ countries.

## Certifications and compliance

- ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System
- CAPEXIL member (Chemicals and Allied Products Export Promotion Council, Government of India)
- Bureau of Indian Standards IS 2653 safety match specification
- EU REACH chemical safety compliant
- Lead-free, non-toxic strike head; zero-afterglow carbonised splints

## Product range

### 1. Household safety matches — https://www.safetymatches.in/household-matches
Pocket wooden matches for daily domestic use and supermarket retail.

| Model | Box size | Splint | Sticks | 20FT FCL | 40FT HC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5S | 49 x 35 x 12 mm | 40 x 2 x 2 mm poplar | ~40 | 1,200 cartons | 2,850 cartons |
| 5E | 51 x 35 x 14 mm | 42 x 2 x 2 mm poplar | ~40 | 1,000 cartons | 2,375 cartons |
| 5H | 52 x 35 x 12 mm | 42 x 2 x 2 mm poplar | ~40 | 1,100 cartons | 2,600 cartons |

Board: white duplex. Head colours: black, brown, red, green. Side friction: plain or dotted. Packing: 10 poly packs x 10 shrink wraps = 1,000 boxes per carton.

### 2. Moisture-proof wax matches — https://www.safetymatches.in/wax-matches
Paraffin-impregnated kraft paper splints for coastal, rainy and high-humidity markets. The highest-volume match type in West Africa, Central America and island nations.

| Model | Box size | Splint | Sticks | Boxes/carton | 20FT FCL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| WM | 40 x 33 x 12 mm | 32 mm paraffin kraft | 40 | 1,000 | 1,500 cartons |
| WSM | 43 x 30 x 10 mm | 30 mm paraffin kraft | 40 | 1,000 | 1,800 cartons |
| 5H | 53 x 37 x 11 mm | 35 mm paraffin kraft | 40 | 600 | 1,850 cartons |
| Wax Kitchen | 70 x 48 x 22 mm | 30/32 mm paraffin kraft | ~200 | 80 | 4,000 cartons |

### 3. Extra long kitchen matches — https://www.safetymatches.in/kitchen-matches
Long, sturdy splints that keep hands clear of the flame when lighting gas stoves, deep oven burners and tall candles.

Head colours: black, red, blue, brown, green.

Extra-thick 3 x 3 mm softwood splints with a wind-resistant extended burn for charcoal grills, camp fires and log fireplaces.

### 5. Custom promotional and hotel matchboxes — https://www.safetymatches.in/promotional-matches
Full OEM private label for hotels, resorts, bars, restaurants and cigar lounges.

| Model | Box size | Splint | Sticks | Boxes/carton |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BX-09 | 112 x 26 x 9 mm | 96 mm | 12 | 1,250 |
| BX-10 | 112 x 17.5 x 17.5 mm | 96 mm | 15 | 1,000 |
| BX-13 / BX-14 | 84 x 18 x 18 mm / 84 x 36 x 9 mm | 80 mm | 15 | 1,000–1,250 |

Finishes: 4-colour wet offset on 300 GSM art board, metallic gold/silver foil stamping, spot UV, soft-touch matte lamination, die-cut templates. Splints: natural poplar or black dyed wood. Match heads in any custom hex shade. Matchbooks available in 10, 20 and 30 strikes.

## Customisation and private label

Importers can specify cover artwork, side striker coating (plain or dotted friction), splint material, match head colour, inner poly/caddy packing and outer carton branding. Free vector die-cut artwork templates are supplied on request.

## Ordering

- **Standard MOQ**: 1 x 20FT FCL (approximately 1,000–1,850 master cartons, depending on box size)
- **Custom OEM runs**: from 500 outer cartons or 10,000 custom units for promotional and kitchen lines
- **Samples**: free physical sample kits dispatched worldwide by express courier on verification of trade credentials
- **Quotations**: FOB and CIF pricing, typically within 12 hours of enquiry
- **Packing for sea freight**: poly/caddy bundling, heavy-duty shrink film, 3-ply or 5-ply corrugated master cartons, palletised and container-sealed against ocean humidity

## Frequently asked questions

- **Q: Where are Glovel matches manufactured?**
  A: At the company's own plant in Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, India, to Bureau of Indian Standards IS 2653.

- **Q: What is the minimum order quantity for export?**
  A: One 20-foot full container load for standard wooden and wax matches; 500 outer cartons for custom promotional runs.

- **Q: Why choose wax matches over wooden matches?**
  A: Wax match splints are kraft paper impregnated with paraffin, so they cannot absorb atmospheric moisture. They remain rigid and ignite reliably in coastal, rainy and tropical conditions where bare wooden splints soften.

- **Q: Can matchboxes be printed with our own brand?**
  A: Yes. Every product line is available as full OEM private label, including cover artwork, splint colour, head colour and outer carton branding.

- **Q: Which port do shipments leave from?**
  A: V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin VOC Port), 90 km from the plant, which allows rapid stuffing and quick bill of lading issuance.
